notes: This portable C++ TCK slice composes adapter-supplied application and update-rate FOM modules. A subject federate passively subscribes to one adapter-selected object-class attribute using an adapter-selected update-rate designator and actively subscribes to one application interaction class. A separate requester subscribes to the three standard MIM report interactions and names the subject with the inherited HLAfederate parameter of HLArequestSubscriptions. The test validates the standard object-class report's class count, handle, inactive state, update-rate name, and exact attribute list; the active interaction report; and the empty directed-interaction NULL response. It uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, public handle decoders, standard encoding DataElements, and the C++ standard library. The provider package, FOM modules, names, endpoint, callback configuration, update-rate name, and logical-time implementation come from the adapter. It does not use DDM regions, private headers, provider registries, or vendor-specific APIs.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void subscribeObjectClassAttributes( ObjectClassHandle const & objectClass, AttributeHandleSet const & attributes, bool active = true, std::wstring const & updateRateDesignator = L"") = 0
